ApiVersion.description: Describe the negotiated version of the internal API contract.
ApiVersion.title: ApiVersion

ArtifactGrantRequest.description: Opaque, operation-scoped artifact capability accepted by the API.
ArtifactGrantRequest.title: ArtifactGrantRequest

CapabilityAction.description: Describe one command exposed by an internal API capability.
CapabilityAction.title: CapabilityAction

CapabilityManifest.description: Describe the internal API capabilities available to a client.
CapabilityManifest.title: CapabilityManifest

CapabilityModule.description: Group the commands exposed by one internal API capability module.
CapabilityModule.title: CapabilityModule

ChatCapability.description: Fixed schema-v1 limits and capabilities for transient chat.
ChatCapability.title: ChatCapability

ChatMessage.description: One bounded user or assistant message at the HTTP boundary.
ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage

ChatRunRequest.description: One bounded generation request for an existing transient session.
ChatRunRequest.title: ChatRunRequest

ChatRunSummary.description: Sanitized provider result with explicit non-evidentiary status.
ChatRunSummary.title: ChatRunSummary

ChatSession.description: Sanitized metadata for one in-memory chat session.
ChatSession.title: ChatSession

ChatSessionCreateRequest.description: Start one explicitly scoped, transient provider-backed chat session.
ChatSessionCreateRequest.title: ChatSessionCreateRequest

ChatStreamRun.description: Sanitized current state for one owner-scoped streaming provider run.
ChatStreamRun.title: ChatStreamRun

ConsentCreateRequest.description: Create a consent only from a current revision and exact preview.
ConsentCreateRequest.title: ConsentCreateRequest

ConsentGrantResponse.description: Persisted consent metadata without payloads or credentials.
ConsentGrantResponse.title: ConsentGrantResponse

ConsentPreviewPayloadRequest.description: Exact previously rendered preview submitted for atomic creation.
ConsentPreviewPayloadRequest.title: ConsentPreviewPayloadRequest

ConsentPreviewRequest.description: Requested disclosure scope rendered before consent creation.
ConsentPreviewRequest.title: ConsentPreviewRequest

ConsentPreviewResponse.description: Authoritative consent disclosure preview and warning set.
ConsentPreviewResponse.title: ConsentPreviewResponse

EndpointValidationResponse.description: Sanitized endpoint-test result with no destination address.
EndpointValidationResponse.title: EndpointValidationResponse

ErrorEnvelope.description: Wrap a sanitized API error with its opaque correlation reference.
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

FailureDetail.description: Describe one sanitized validation failure returned by the internal API.
FailureDetail.title: FailureDetail

GedcomInspectOperationRequest.description: Inspect one GEDCOM through a read-only scoped grant.
GedcomInspectOperationRequest.title: GedcomInspectOperationRequest

GedcomMergeOperationRequest.description: Merge GEDCOM inputs into new GEDCOM and quality-report artifacts.
GedcomMergeOperationRequest.title: GedcomMergeOperationRequest

GedcomProviderSelectionRequest.description: Explicit offline or consent-bound provider selection for GEDCOM work.
GedcomProviderSelectionRequest.title: GedcomProviderSelectionRequest

GedcomQualityOperationRequest.description: Analyze a rooted GEDCOM and publish a new quality report.
GedcomQualityOperationRequest.title: GedcomQualityOperationRequest

GedcomResultResponse.description: Structured completed GEDCOM result without paths or raw records.
GedcomResultResponse.title: GedcomResultResponse

GedcomSubtreeOperationRequest.description: Extract one rooted GEDCOM subtree into a new artifact.
GedcomSubtreeOperationRequest.title: GedcomSubtreeOperationRequest

GedcomSyncOperationRequest.description: Run a typed update or rebase without accepting unrestricted paths.
GedcomSyncOperationRequest.title: GedcomSyncOperationRequest

GedcomSyncSnapshotRequest.description: One path-free website export supplied to a sync update.
GedcomSyncSnapshotRequest.title: GedcomSyncSnapshotRequest

HealthResponse.description: Expose sanitized service health and API compatibility metadata.
HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse

JobArtifactResponse.description: Opaque completed-job artifact descriptor; host paths are never exposed.
JobArtifactResponse.title: JobArtifactResponse

JobProgressResponse.description: Bounded progress metadata without operation payloads.
JobProgressResponse.title: JobProgressResponse

JobShutdownResponse.description: Explicit authorization for Electron to terminate the sidecar.
JobShutdownResponse.title: JobShutdownResponse

JobSnapshotResponse.description: Renderer-safe current state for one restart-safe background job.
JobSnapshotResponse.title: JobSnapshotResponse

PageMetadata.description: Describe the page boundary and continuation cursor returned by an API listing.
PageMetadata.title: PageMetadata

PaginationPolicy.description: Define validated pagination policy values for runtime decisions.
PaginationPolicy.title: PaginationPolicy

PaginationRequest.description: Carry validated cursor and page-size inputs for one API listing request.
PaginationRequest.title: PaginationRequest

ProviderConfigurationMutationRequest.description: Revision precondition for a provider configuration mutation.
ProviderConfigurationMutationRequest.title: ProviderConfigurationMutationRequest

ProviderProfileCreateRequest.description: Atomic profile creation based on the last reviewed snapshot.
ProviderProfileCreateRequest.title: ProviderProfileCreateRequest

ProviderProfileResponse.description: Provider configuration safe for an untrusted renderer.
ProviderProfileResponse.title: ProviderProfileResponse

RequestSizePolicy.description: Define validated request size policy values for runtime decisions.
RequestSizePolicy.title: RequestSizePolicy

SecretSetRequest.description: Write-only secret input that is never returned by the API.
SecretSetRequest.title: SecretSetRequest

SettingValidationResponse.description: Reviewed renderer constraints for one non-secret setting.
SettingValidationResponse.title: SettingValidationResponse

SettingsPatchRequest.description: Allowlisted settings changes based on a previously read revision.
SettingsPatchRequest.title: SettingsPatchRequest

SettingsResponse.description: Versioned settings snapshot with an optimistic-lock revision.
SettingsResponse.title: SettingsResponse

StartupDiagnosticReportResponse.description: Schema-v1 startup report consumed by Electron main and the renderer.
StartupDiagnosticReportResponse.title: StartupDiagnosticReportResponse

StartupPlatformResponse.description: Non-sensitive platform details for relevant local remediation.
StartupPlatformResponse.title: StartupPlatformResponse

PrivateBearer.description: Fresh per-launch 256-bit bearer supplied privately by Electron main.

info.description: Authenticated internal discovery only. This is not a public, LAN, or browser API.
